amendments.consequence: Offline adjudication becomes the primary defence, not the quiet machine: the 0xDEADBEEF poison, both sentinels and the full 16-GPR dump decide whether a dispatch really ran, per EXP-0160's evidence-validity filter (two agreeing clean dumps win outright -- contamination can destroy an observation but never fabricate a coherent one). harness/procsample.py records what was ACTUALLY running for the duration into raw/<run>/03_procsample.jsonl, so concurrency is a measurement rather than an assumption, and a contaminated stretch can be located by timestamp against sweep.jsonl's own `t`.
amendments.touches: WHEN the runs execute, and which anti-contamination instrument is primary. Nothing in program construction, splicing, poisoning, majority-of-3, victim classification, the sentinels, the oracles, outcome classification, the coverage rule or the promotion gate changes.
amendments.what: Both gated runs execute UNLOCKED and CONCURRENTLY with sibling experiments. PRE_REGISTRATION section 5 said they would run in an orchestrator-coordinated quiet window; that is superseded for every arm except DSTORE.
amendments.why: Orchestrator ruling 2026-08-30. FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL section 7 is the standing directive -- ordinary sweeps run unlocked; only CONFIRMATION passes need a quiet machine -- and serializing costs far more than the contamination does. EXP-0168, EXP-0171 and EXP-0172 run alongside.

amendments.touches: which fields get a VERDICT. Every field is still swept; only the ruling is withheld. Device field count unchanged at 57.
amendments.what: `get_sr.dst_hi` CONFIRMED in this experiment's verdict scope. `get_sr.form` moved OUT: it belongs to EXP-0172 (a 'one-field-away' row). FOREIGN_FIELDS becomes per-descriptor: {'dst' (any descriptor, EXP-0168), 'get_sr.form' (EXP-0172)}.
amendments.why: Orchestrator ruling 2026-08-30: EXP-0168 owns the field NAME `dst` exactly; `dst_hi` is a different name and a different bit span. get_sr is therefore touched by three experiments on DISJOINT fields.

amendments.touches: run scheduling and analysis pairing. analysis/verdicts.py now accepts N run directories and, PER FIELD, uses the two runs that reached the most distinct attributed values -- EXP-0164 cross_run's own rule -- so the DSTORE pair is not diluted by pair 1. No case, encoding, oracle or gate changes.
amendments.what: TWO gated pairs instead of one. Pair 1 = g17p_20260830_run01 / run02, every arm EXCEPT DSTORE. Pair 2 = g17p_20260830_run03 / run04, DSTORE ONLY, run LAST, after pair 1's raw has been pulled back, and only after telling the orchestrator so the other agents are held off the machine for its duration.
amendments.why: Orchestrator ruling 2026-08-30. The DSTORE arm sweeps device_store.base_slot 0..255, i.e. stores through UNBOUND binding slots -- exactly the hang-prone case FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL section 7 carves out of the run-unlocked rule. Running it last means a wedge costs one arm, not the experiment.

amendments.touches: analysis output only. No device behaviour, no gate, no case.
amendments.what: analysis/recitation.py now also reports, per citation-recoverable field, the fraction of the field's ENCODABLE RANGE the passing arm actually dispatched.
amendments.why: Self-falsification of this experiment's own headline offline finding. EXP-0164's gate (stable_live) has NO coverage term -- THIN_COMMON=8 exists in audit.py but only sets an informational `thin_cross_run` flag and is never consulted by stable_live. So `RECOVERABLE-BY-CITATION` means 'clears EXP-0164's gate', NOT 'meets the docs/evidence-classification.md section 2 hardware-run RANGE bar'. Only 4 of the 12 clear it over the full encodable range; the other 8 clear it on as little as 2 of 64 values. Reporting the 12 without that column would have overstated them.
